description: Sabaragamuwa Province Council - Rent Act No. 7 of 1972
reasoning: This gazette notification amends the areas where the Rent Act, No. 7 of 1972 shall be implemented within the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It is an amendment to a legal/regulatory framework (the Rent Act) and involves modifying the schedule of areas under its jurisdiction. The content focuses on the legal implementation of an existing act rather than government personnel changes, organisational structure, or other specialized categories like land, commercial, or public service matters.
